title: Priklen’s Machines
description: Pricklen’s Machines is a small mod that adds a bunch (only one for now) of machines, that bring new ways of crafting to Minecraft!
body:
Pricklen’s Machines is a mod, that adds various (only one for now) machines to be used in tech-focused modpacks and was originally created to be used in one.

Current contents:
- Kiln multiblock machine
- Fireclay Bricks + Cracked Fireclay Bricks + Mossy Fireclay Bricks decorative blockset

Current compatibilities/integrations:
- [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade)
- [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)
- [KubeJS](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs) (see github)
